title: Summers home; the capitol dedication in Jefferson City
summary: Thomas completed four years, went home each summer, and the band was away three days for the dedication of the new capitol.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: But, I mean you made the full four years?
And you'd go home each summer?
Well, that's a funny thing that you asked me about that. Yes, I would go home each summer but during some of these times, like the dedication of the capital, we were out for three days.
Now what was this dedication to the capital?
Well, they had an idea to rededicate the capital. They built a new capitol there.
Oh, is that the capital of Missouri?
Oh, I didn't realize that. That's why, yeah.
A very beautiful town right on the banks of the Missouri River there, you know. And, the president's lawn by down/the river.
Oh, I see what you meant by that joke ...
